description.narrative:
RADEZA - a Civil Society Network for Environment and Sustainable Community Develppment of Zambezia Province, is a civil society network that work into the Natural Resources created in 9th , November 2005, with the objective to coordinate, develop and facilitatethe promotion of the sustainable community development programs and its associates through institutional development for influencing and representation in the local, regional and internacional development agenda.
in the Natural Resources Resilent initiative, RADEZA will strengthen the capacity of the local civil society platforms to operate within the climate change field, which will providedirect support to communities affected by climate chock variability, climate change adaptation, support to harness local knowledgeand incorporate into the climate change adaptation practices and behaviour. So, its expected that RADEZA contribute to the Output 1.1. The capacity of two local natural resources platforms (one in Maganja da Costa and 1 Milange) in the Zambezia province is built and they directly support 8 local communities (5 in Maganja da Costa and 3 in Milange). • Awareness rasing in the communities: Carry out awareness raising campaigns on the impact of climate change and sensitize communities to implement nature-based climate change adaptation; • Maintain and keep alive the local SOS Response to Cyclone Freddy and will continue promoting volunteers work to support the victims of the cyclone. They intend to incentive community to build resilient houses and compounds. • 8 communities (3 in Milange and 5 in Maganja districts) will pilot nature-based solutions initiatives, 1 per community: Examples of initiatives are: In Mussaia community, they intend to promote conservation agriculture, with direct support of Oxfam improved seed, and support from SDAE-Servicos Distrital de Actividades Economicas – this public institution will provide technical support through rural extension, for the use of mproved technics/technologies and the use of agriculture mechanisms, latrine slabs for construction of latrines in communities, providing trees for communities and promote planting trees around the yards and patios of the houses, putting bags of sands to the places where erosions normally happen, they will implement and incentive members of community to build houses with 4 sides to facilitate running of water during the raining season; rreforestation as a way to minimize the erosion and floods.
